gitCommit.subject: Cover the unlink message, the one case a create cannot reach
gitCommit.body:
Cover the unlink message, the one case a create cannot reach

Re-anchoring forward releases the transactions the retyped figure now covers,
so the balance drops without the user asking — the message worth pinning most.
Only an update can produce it, so this drives the list, detail, and edit screens
with their own route stubs rather than the create-from-template path.

Two things the app taught the spec, both now noted where they bite: the modal
submit control renders without a button role, and auto-sync with no categories
or accounts is a combination the edit form refuses to submit.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
